It follows the same distinctive operative sequence: a public-interest recital; presidential proclamation under statutory authority; establishment or reservation of specifically described lands subject to existing rights; an acreage total; an express warning against appropriation, injury, destruction, defacement, removal, and settlement; and supervision by the Director of the National Park Service under the Secretary of the Interior pursuant to the 1916 National Park Service Act.
